messages.subject: [R-SIG-Win]  When can we expect further versions of R for Windows on ARM?
messages.subject_clean: When can we expect further versions of R for Windows on ARM?
messages.body_plain:
They're not signed, but you can find release builds at the r-hub github 
repo. For instance: https://github.com/r-hub/R/releases/tag/v4.6.1

-Andrew

On 2026-08-25 12:43, Krzysztof Dmytr?w via R-SIG-windows wrote:
> Dear All,
> 
> As far as I am aware, Tomas Kalibera led the development of R for 
> Windows on ARM machines. His much too early passing stopped the 
> development of this version of R. Because I own a Snapdragon Elite X 
> based system, I am very interested on continuation of work for this 
> architecture. The last version available is R-4.5.3. When can we expect 
> further versions of R for Windows on ARM systems?
> 
> I hope my question will not be considered as spam or anything like 
> this. I looked at FAQ pages and hadn't seen any information on this. I 
> know that my issue is very specific and quite niche.
> 
> Thank you,
> 
> Krzysztof
